data.name: Mokbul
data.gender_notes: Mokbul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-b-l', meaning 'to give'. Mokbul refers to a gift or blessing from Allah. The name Mokbul carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mokbul usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the blessings and gifts bestowed by Allah.
data.etymology: Mokbul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mokbul total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مكبول
in_arabic.long_meaning: مكبول هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المقبول أو المرتقب أو المأمول، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى المأمول أو المقبول. و يدل على معنى الأمل والترقب للمستقبل، و الشخص الذي يحمل هذا الاسم يتصف بالتفاؤل و الأمل.

in_urdu.name: مکبول
in_urdu.long_meaning: مکبول ایک اردو نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مقبول یا مرتقب یا مأمول۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ آمل اور مستقبل کی توقعات سے وابستہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मकबूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मकबूल एक हिंदी नाम है जिसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं। इसका अर्थ है मकबूल या मर्तकब या ममूल। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत आम है और आशा और भविष्य की उम्मीदों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: مکبول
in_pashto.long_meaning: مکبول د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی، چي د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د منقبل یا مأمول معنی لري او د افغاني او پښتني ټولنې کې کارول کیږي.

The name Mokbul appears in various forms across Muslim cultures and is associated with positive qualities such as hope, optimism, and promise.

Further, the name is also a reminder of the importance of expressing gratitude towards Allah for His blessings and gifts.

historical_references.context: Mokbul ibn Marwan was a prominent Khwarazmian Turk who ruled the city of Herat. He was a vassal of the Seljuk Sultan of Rum, Sultan Kilij Arslan II. Mokbul is reported to have turned against Sultan Kilij Arslan II and captured the city of Herat.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Asakir's Tarikh Madinat Dimashq, Volume 30, Page 318 The name Mokbul carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mokbul ibn Abi Talib, a descendant of Imam Ali, ruled Damascus and its surrounding region from the Umayyad Mosque. He was a prominent figure during the Ayyubid period and had a significant role in the defense of the city against the Mongols.
